top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing health statements.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching Television while eating and drinking their bottles.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

top_violation_types.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider was missing five of the additional training content courses.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
